concept.cross_view_consistency_note: Reject first generated concept pit-centered knobs, tree-like veins and overly thick relief. Second concept is useful for three low curved ridges, but still exaggerates pits and repeated ridge grooves; reduce both to shallow subordinate surface relief, no central knobs in pits. Single integrated surface avoids floating anatomical tubes. Palette artistic, 40mm nominal diameter.
